title: Export to CSV is timing out

context.author: Dana K.
context.text: Hi, the CSV export on our workspace has been spinning for 20 minutes. We need the report for a board meeting tomorrow morning. Is there a workaround?

draft:
Hi Dana,

Sorry about that. Exports over 50,000 rows run in the background, and the progress bar does not update for them, which is a bug we are fixing.

Your export finished at 09:14 and is in Settings > Exports. If you need it filtered to one quarter, the Date filter on the report page cuts the file size by about 70%.

I'll check back tomorrow at 8am to make sure you have what you need for the meeting.
rationale: Customer has a hard deadline tomorrow; the export actually completed, so the answer is concrete.

title: SSO login loop

context.author: Ifeoma A.
context.text: After enabling SSO our users get redirected back to the login page over and over.

draft:
Hi Ifeoma,

A login loop right after enabling SSO is almost always the callback URL. In your identity provider, the reply URL needs to be exactly https://app.example.com/sso/callback, with no trailing slash.

If that's already set, send me the timestamp of one failed attempt and I'll pull the log for it.
rationale: Most common cause per KB; asks for one piece of data if it isn't that.

title: Reply: thread on approval steps for AI agents

context.author: @demo_rae
context.text: Hot take: every AI agent that sends anything to a customer needs a human approval step for at least the first month. Change my mind.

draft: Agree, and the first month tells you which approvals to keep. We log every edit the reviewer makes. Drafts that get approved untouched three weeks running are candidates for auto-send; drafts that keep getting rewritten tell you what the agent doesn't know yet.
rationale: On-topic for the product; adds a specific practice rather than agreeing.

title: Forum: webhook retries

context.author: demo_river
context.text: Do webhooks retry if my endpoint returns 500? How many times?

draft: Yes. A 5xx or a timeout (10s) is retried 5 times with exponential backoff: 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 minutes. A 4xx is not retried. Each attempt carries the same X-Delivery-Id header so you can dedupe on your side.
rationale: Factual answer from the API docs.
